questions.question: What does the + operator do with numbers?

correct.title: Correct! 🎉
correct.details: With numbers, + performs addition. With strings, it concatenates (joins) them together.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: With numbers, + performs addition. With strings, it concatenates (joins) them together.

questions.question: Which operator gives the remainder of division?

correct.title: Correct! 🎉
correct.details: The modulus operator % returns the remainder after division. For example, 10 % 3 equals 1.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔

questions.question: What does return do in a function?

correct.title: Correct! 🎉
correct.details: return sends a value back from the function to where it was called. Functions without return give undefined.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: return sends a value back from the function to where it was called. Functions without return give undefined.

questions.question: What is x in function double(x) { ... }?

correct.details: x is a parameter - a placeholder for the value that will be passed into the function when it's called.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
